description: This file defines the LookupTableData class, which encapsulates data related to a lookup table, including a key, description, and a list of entries.

classes.name: LookupTableData
classes.description: A POJO (Plain Old Java Object) class representing lookup table information with key, description, and list of entries.

methods.name: LookupTableData
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing key, description, and entries.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key associated with the lookup table.

methods.description: Sets the key for the lookup table.

methods.name: getDescription

methods.name: setDescription
